blocks.text: Calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) limestone, marble aur chalk ki shakal mein milta hai. Yeh imaarti saman (building material) ke taur par, cement aur concrete mein, aur kaghaz aur plastic mein filler (bharti ka madda) ke taur par bohat istemal hota hai. Calcium oxide (CaO, quicklime) aur calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂, slaked lime) cement, mortar aur plaster banane mein istemal hote hain. Quicklime steel banane mein mel (impurities) nikalne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai. Calcium sulphate (CaSO₄·2H₂O, gypsum) se plasterboard (drywall) aur plaster of Paris (CaSO₄·½H₂O) banaye jate hain.

Calcium oxide (CaO) aur calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) "flue gas desulphurization" (wet scrubbing, yani geeli safai) mein istemal hote hain, jahan yeh power plants ke dhuen se tezaabi sulphur dioxide (SO₂) nikal kar acid rain (tezaabi barish) ko rokte hain. Magnesium oxide (MgO) ka melting point bohat zyada hai, is liye yeh refractory material (bhattiyon ki andar ki teh) ke taur par istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Magnesium (metal) halke alloys (maslan hawai jahaz aur gaariyon ke purze), fireworks aur flares mein istemal hoti hai, kyunke yeh tez roshni se jalti hai. Strontium compounds fireworks aur flares mein laal rang dete hain. Beryllium alloys ki mazbooti barhane (maslan springs, aerospace ke purze) aur X-ray tubes mein istemal hota hai, kyunke X-rays is mein se guzar jati hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: SO₂ ek acidic oxide hai aur CaO/CaCO₃ basic hain; dono react kar ke thos calcium sulphite/sulphate bana dete hain, is liye SO₂ hawa mein nahi jati aur acid rain nahi banti.

blocks.prompt: Calcium compounds acid rain rokne mein kaise madad karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Flue gas desulphurization mein CaO ya CaCO₃ (basic) power plant ki gases ki acidic SO₂ se react kar ke use hawa tak pohanchne se pehle hi nikal dete hain.
